title: What the snipe path does when something fails after the buy may have been broadcast

options.name: Keep current behaviour: one catch treats every error as a clean zero-spend failure
options.risk: A landed buy can end with no row, a failed row, or no exit and anti-rug monitoring, never re-armed even after restart, while the operator is told nothing was spent (AUD-BUY-002 traces).

options.name: On any throw after the submit started, reconcile against chain truth (token balance delta and nonce) before deciding
options.behavior_impact: If tokens arrived, record the row and arm monitoring; only a proven non-landing is reported as zero spend.
options.risk: Extra RPC reads in the failure path; a wrong reconcile result must fail toward "held".

options.name: Write a pending intent row before broadcasting, then confirm or fail it from chain truth
options.behavior_impact: A broadcast buy always has a row, so dedup, risk limits and boot resume see it even if the process dies mid-buy.
options.risk: Rows for buys that never landed must be cleaned up correctly, or they block the token and count against limits.

options.name: Split submit from bookkeeping: post-landing steps retry and alert, never mark failed
options.behavior_impact: Bookkeeping errors after a returned hash become loud "held and unprotected" alerts with retries instead of a failed row.
options.risk: Does not cover the strategy-throws-but-landed cases (trace 2) on its own.

recommendation: intent-row-first together with reconcile-on-throw (covers every trace, including the strategy throwing after a broadcast), using the inserted row id for all later links (AUD-BUY-020) and one transaction for the post-buy writes where possible.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S0/S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides how the bot records and protects a buy whose bookkeeping fails.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
